label: Q-02
title: Story-103 rewire respec turns a self-healing condition into a griefable DoS: dropping the step-2 skim makes a 1-wei unsynced pair donation fail simulation, and the current _assertRetired owner-BPT==0 require must be removed or a 1-wei BPT donation to OWNER griefs the run
rootCause: Story 103 checklist (L202) specifies step 2 as assert reserves AND balances (0,0) with no skim, whereas escrow.exitAndSeed would harmlessly skim exactly that donation; _assertRetired L552-553 conflicts with the 2026-10-10 'must not revert on non-zero owner BPT' amendment.
description: Story 103 (incomplete, checklist L202) has step 2 DROP the skim and 'only assert the pair is empty (reserves AND balances (0,0))'. With the skim gone, a 1-wei UNSYNCED transfer to the pair fails the simulation at step 2. Yet escrow.exitAndSeed would harmlessly skim exactly that donation to newPooler (escrow L365-366). The spec turns a self-healing condition into a griefable DoS. Separately, the current core's _assertRetired (L551-554) requires owner BPT == 0. Story 103 (L203) correctly says the rewired core must NOT revert on non-zero owner BPT. That require has to be removed in the rewire, or a 1-wei BPT donation to OWNER before simulation becomes a grief.

attackPath: 1. Story 103 rewire drops the step-2 skim and asserts reserves AND balances == (0,0)
2. Griefer transfers 1 wei to the pair (unsynced) or 1 wei BPT to OWNER
3. Simulation fails at step 2 / _assertRetired; nothing broadcasts
failureScenario.assumptions: Story 103 implemented as currently written (checklist L202/L203)

impact: Liveness only, marginal (an attacker can already sync -- the 9a694ae01fe1 brick).
assetImpact: None; liveness grief of the future rewired run via a 1-wei unsynced pair donation or 1-wei BPT donation to OWNER.

evidence.notes: Spec-level; story 103 implementation not in tree at a4f9f3c.

recommendation: In the rewire, assert reserves == (0,0) only and leave balances to the escrow's skim. Drop the owner-BPT clause from _assertRetired.

classification.justification: Spec-level, not in tree at a4f9f3c. The outcome is a fail-closed simulation grief that is strictly weaker than the already-ledgered sync brick (9a694ae01fe1), so marginal liveness. Its value is a pre-implementation correction to story 103: assert reserves only, leave balances to the escrow's skim, and drop the owner-BPT clause in _assertRetired. QA with a faithfulness tag (story-unsafe, Law 1 marginal). Disclose ycn L-26 alongside.
classification.specConformanceCrossRef: List in spec-conformance.md under story 103 as a story-unsafe (Law-1 marginal) note referencing Q-02; no separate F label.

relatedFindings: DEDUP-009 (owner-BPT _assertRetired clause also listed as an unlanded obligation)
sanitizerNote: Related to 9a694ae01fe1 and ycn L-26 (wont-fix), not the same defect. L-26 accepted a fail-loud SYNCED donation against the escrow; DEDUP-007 is story-103's respec turning an UNSYNCED donation (which the escrow skim self-heals) into a grief, plus the _assertRetired owner-BPT==0 clause that conflicts with the 2026-10-10 amendment. The spec makes the system strictly worse than the state the owner accepted. Disclose L-26 alongside.
pocNote: Low/QA/F: no submission PoC required; fork evidence listed under evidence.
